title: 8th Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/8/2/2026).

Question by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Tourism and Civil Aviation Mohamed Ameen: has the wide-body aircraft the government recently brought in to expand air services delivered the expected gains, what routes does it currently fly, and when will flights to destinations other than China and India begin?

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request for Parliament's consent to a member appointed to the Privatization and Corporatization Board, under Article 4(a) and (b) of Law No. 3/2013, is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Continuation of the debate on the Maldives 2.0 Digital Transformation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Gadhdhoo MP Mohamed Ali.
Continuation of the debate on the Digital Identity Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Alifushi MP Abdul Latheef Abdul Rahman.

Report of the Government Oversight Committee on the President's submission, under Article 116(a) of the Constitution, seeking Parliament's approval of the revised mandates of ministries whose names and functions were changed.
Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on the President's nomination for President of the Elections Commission, under Article 7(b) of the Elections Commission Act (Law No. 8/2008).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the tourism minister on the national airline's wide-body aircraft, sent a Privatization Board appointment to committee, continued the digital bills debates, and took committee reports on revised ministry mandates and the Elections Commission president nominee.
